title: Finally figured out a good photo backup strategy
body: I was stressing about backing up all the family photos and realized I needed a system that wasn't just relying on one cloud service. I started using an external hard drive and keeping one copy on it physically, and then I use a different cloud service for the actual remote backup. It sounds a bit redundant, but having that physical copy is so much more peace of mind, especially when dealing with sentimental stuff. It's a two-pronged approach that feels much safer than just trusting one place.
